From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jenkins <samantha.jenkins@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>

Subject: Buy flow playbook & MAP check-in — legal→security→finance timeline + marketplace option

Hi Samantha / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the call today — good alignment across product, procurement and security. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared playbook.

High-level agreed commercial path
- Primary path: Redwood standard SOW + PO (NET30) issued by Acme finance.
- Pilot option: card payment acceptable for initial 30-day pilot to speed time-to-value.
- Marketplace: you expressed interest in marketplace listing (Azure/AWS). We can support this but it’s an additional onboarding track and may add ~2–3 weeks.

Estimated milestone timeline (ballpark from Redwood side)
- Redwood provides redlined SOW and procurement packet: by 2026-10-30 (owner: Redwood legal / pri): 1–2 business days.
- Acme legal review + sign-off: ~5–10 business days (target: complete by 2026-11-06).
- Security questionnaire & evidence review: Acme security to complete review; Redwood will provide pre-filled questionnaire and scan summary (target exchange by 2026-11-13).
- Finance onboarding & PO issuance: once legal OK, finance typically issues PO in 3–7 business days (target: by 2026-11-17).

Attachments I’m including: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), redwood_standard_SOW_v3.pdf (template), security-scan-summary.pdf (current scan).

Asks from Acme for next steps
1) Confirm preferred commercial instrument for pilot/contract: PO (NET30) or card for pilot?
2) Confirm primary legal and procurement contacts (names + emails) and preferred internal SLAs for review.
3) If marketplace is preferred, confirm target marketplace (AWS / Azure) so we route onboarding.

Proposed short cadence: 15-min MAP sync next Wednesday (2026-11-03) to keep momentum — ok?

Thanks — I’ll queue up the SOW redline and MAP now.

Best,
Priyom Das

Subject: Re: Buy flow playbook & MAP check-in — legal→security→finance timeline + marketplace option

Priyom — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers and questions from our side.

1) Payment instrument: For pilot we prefer card to move fast; for production we will want a PO/NET30 unless Marketplace is used and handles billing.
2) Internal timing: our legal team typically needs ~10 business days for a first-pass review (they’ll fast-track on standardized SOWs), security will run the questionnaire and a brief review in parallel (expect ~5 business days), finance can issue a PO within ~5–7 business days after legal sign-off.
3) Marketplace: we are most likely to go via Azure Marketplace if onboarding is straightforward — please confirm whether Redwood needs any additional paperwork to enable Azure listing (tax forms, reseller agreements, etc.).

A couple of requests from procurement/security: can Redwood pre-fill the security questionnaire and return any pen-test / SOC2 evidence? Also please share a short vendor onboarding checklist so our procurement team has a clear intake path.

I’ll loop in our legal lead separately, but procurement contact for PO is procurement@acme.com.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Jenkins

Samantha — quick clarifications from commercial/ops perspective.

- Payment & billing: Redwood accepts card for pilots and company PO for production. Standard PO terms are NET30; we can discuss NET45/60 only for enterprise committed spends (we’ll need a finance approval).
- Marketplace: we currently support AWS Marketplace & Azure Marketplace. Azure listing requires an additional onboarding package (tax W-9/W-8 and a partner enrollment) that typically adds ~2–3 weeks. If Acme prefers Azure and speed is critical, card or direct PO is faster.
- Vendor onboarding: we’ve attached a short checklist and the SOW template to make your legal intake easier. If you want, we’ll fill the SOW with the commercial terms we discussed and send a redline the same day.

I’ve attached: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf and redwood_standard_SOW_v3.pdf (same SOW as in the MAP pack).

Proposed internal owners from Redwood:
- Legal redline & SOW owner: Redwood Legal (Ben C.)
- Security evidence & questionnaire owner: Redwood Security (will share scans & SOC pointers)
- Commercial & billing: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com)

If that aligns, Priyom — please confirm whether Acme will route the SOW to legal this week. If legal can aim for sign-off by 2026-11-06 we can hit the PO issuance target of 2026-11-17.

Thanks,

Thanks team — putting a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) here to lock dates and owners. Please confirm or update by EOD Monday.

Mutual Action Plan (proposed)
- 2026-10-30: Redwood sends redlined SOW and completed vendor onboarding checklist (owner: Priyom / Ben) — DONE (see attachments).
- 2026-11-06: Acme legal first-pass & feedback (owner: Acme Legal).
- 2026-11-13: Security questionnaire completed & evidence exchanged (owner: Acme Security / Redwood Security).
- 2026-11-17: Finance issues PO (NET30) OR production billing via Marketplace (owner: Acme Finance / Acme Procurement).
- 2026-11-03: Weekly 15-min MAP sync — proposed cadence, first sync (owner: Priyom)

Open decisions for Acme:
1) Pilot payment instrument (card vs PO) — card recommended to shorten time-to-value.
2) Marketplace preference (Azure vs AWS) — Azure chosen implies extra onboarding steps.

If you confirm pilot=card and marketplace=defer -> we can run pilot within 48 hours of payment and keep production on an accelerated legal-to-PO path. If you prefer marketplace billing end-to-end, please confirm and we’ll start the Azure onboarding immediately.

Action items for Acme by Monday EOD (2026-11-02):
- Confirm payment instrument for pilot (card / PO)
- Provide legal contact name & email for SOW routing
- Confirm marketplace preference (Azure / AWS / none)

I’ll schedule the 15-min MAP sync for 2026-11-03 10:00 AM PT unless you suggest a different time.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a short call if that helps unblock.

Best,
